B1L06-2-16.english: This weekend we are going to ride bicycles.

B1L06-2-19.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng yào sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
B1L06-2-19.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend's birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

B1L06-3-02.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge Táiwān péngyǒu.

B1L06-3-04.english: We all like to learn Chinese.

B1L06-3-12.chinese: 我平常喜歡喝茶，有(的)時候喝一點兒咖啡。
B1L06-3-12.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng xǐhuān hē chá, yǒu(de) shíhou hē yìdiǎnr kāfēi.
B1L06-3-12.english: I usually like to drink tea; sometimes I drink a little coffee.

B1L07-1-01.english: How do you sing this song?

B1L07-1-02.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào tā jiā qù.
B1L07-1-02.english: I want to go to his home.

B1L07-1-03.chinese: 我後天要到這家飯店去看朋友。
B1L07-1-03.pinyin: Wǒ hòutiān yào dào zhè jiā fàndiàn qù kàn péngyǒu.
B1L07-1-03.english: The day after tomorrow I am going to this hotel to see a friend.

B1L07-1-05.chinese: 我今天想找朋友去吃飯。
B1L07-1-05.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān xiǎng zhǎo péngyǒu qù chīfàn.
B1L07-1-05.english: Today I want to find a friend to go eat.

B1L07-1-07.chinese: 我每天早上八點半到學校。
B1L07-1-07.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn bàn dào xuéxiào.
B1L07-1-07.english: I arrive at school at 8:30 every morning.

B1L07-1-08.chinese: 我的朋友在那家旅館前面等我。
B1L07-1-08.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu zài nà jiā lǚguǎn qiánmiàn děng wǒ.
B1L07-1-08.english: My friend is waiting for me in front of that hotel.

B1L07-1-09.chinese: 你想坐捷運去，還是坐公車去？
B1L07-1-09.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zuò jiéyùn qù, háishì zuò gōngchē qù?
B1L07-1-09.english: Do you want to take the MRT, or take the bus?

B1L07-1-10.chinese: 你想坐捷運去，還是坐公車去？
B1L07-1-10.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zuò jiéyùn qù, háishì zuò gōngchē qù?
B1L07-1-10.english: Do you want to take the MRT, or take the bus?

B1L07-1-11.chinese: 你想坐捷運去，還是坐公車去？
B1L07-1-11.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zuò jiéyùn qù, háishì zuò gōngchē qù?
B1L07-1-11.english: Do you want to take the MRT, or take the bus?

B1L07-1-16.pinyin: Nǐ yào zài zhèlǐ xià chē ma?
B1L07-1-16.english: Do you want to get off the bus here?

B1L07-1-17.chinese: 他家有點兒遠，我們可以坐捷運去嗎？
B1L07-1-17.pinyin: Tā jiā yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, wǒmen kěyǐ zuò jiéyùn qù ma?
B1L07-1-17.english: His home is a bit far; can we take the MRT there?

B1L07-1-19.chinese: 他很喜歡喝茶，我想你可以送他一些台灣茶。
B1L07-1-19.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān hē chá, wǒ xiǎng nǐ kěyǐ sòng tā yīxiē Táiwān chá.
B1L07-1-19.english: He really likes drinking tea; I think you can give him some Taiwan tea.

B1L07-1-20.chinese: 他要從他家走路去學校。
B1L07-1-20.pinyin: Tā yào cóng tā jiā zǒulù qù xuéxiào.
B1L07-1-20.english: He wants to walk from his home to school.

B1L07-1-22.chinese: 那家餐廳很近，我們走路去吧！
B1L07-1-22.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng hěn jìn, wǒmen zǒulù qù ba!
B1L07-1-22.english: That restaurant is very close; let's walk there!

B1L07-1-23.chinese: 我很餓，我們可以先吃飯嗎？
B1L07-1-23.pinyin: Wǒ hěn è, wǒmen kěyǐ xiān chīfàn ma?
B1L07-1-23.english: I'm very hungry; can we eat first?

B1L07-1-24.chinese: 這張地圖上有十多家餐廳，我們要去哪一家？
B1L07-1-24.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú shàng yǒu shí duō jiā cāntīng, wǒmen yào qù nǎ yī jiā?
B1L07-1-24.english: There are more than ten restaurants on this map; which one do we want to go to?

B1L07-1-25.chinese: 明天是爸爸的生日，我要送他一個錶。
B1L07-1-25.pinyin: Míngtiān shì bàba de shēngrì, wǒ yào sòng tā yī gè biǎo.
B1L07-1-25.english: Tomorrow is Dad's birthday; I want to give him a watch.

B1L07-1-26.pinyin: Wǒ lèi le, bù xiǎng zǒu le.
B1L07-1-26.english: I'm tired now, so I don't want to walk anymore.

B1L07-2-01.english: There are many cars on the road.

B1L07-2-03.pinyin: Xiànzài zhè tiáo jiē shàng méiyǒu chē.
B1L07-2-03.english: There are no cars on this street now.

B1L07-2-04.chinese: 這個地方好漂亮，我好喜歡。
B1L07-2-04.pinyin: Zhège dìfāng hǎo piàoliang, wǒ hǎo xǐhuān.
B1L07-2-04.english: This place is so beautiful; I really like it.

B1L07-2-05.chinese: 學校附近有很多飲料店。
B1L07-2-05.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu hěn duō yǐnliào diàn.
B1L07-2-05.english: There are many beverage shops near the school.

B1L07-2-10.chinese: 我要到郵局去寄信，也要買一些信封。
B1L07-2-10.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào yóujú qù jì xìn, yě yào mǎi yīxiē xìnfēng.
B1L07-2-10.english: I want to go to the post office to mail a letter, and also buy some envelopes.

B1L07-2-12.chinese: 我要到超級市場去買蛋。
B1L07-2-12.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào chāojí shìchǎng qù mǎi dàn.
B1L07-2-12.english: I want to go to the supermarket to buy eggs.

B1L07-2-13.chinese: 我明天有空，一定可以去。
B1L07-2-13.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yǒu kòng, yīdìng kěyǐ qù.
B1L07-2-13.english: I'm free tomorrow, so I can definitely go.

B1L07-2-14.chinese: 這種巧克力冰淇淋又便宜又好吃。
B1L07-2-14.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qiǎokèlì bīngqílín yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
B1L07-2-14.english: This kind of chocolate ice cream is both cheap and delicious.

B1L07-2-15.chinese: 我每天坐捷運去上課，我覺得很方便。
B1L07-2-15.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zuò jiéyùn qù shàngkè, wǒ juéde hěn fāngbiàn.
B1L07-2-15.english: I take the MRT to class every day; I think it's very convenient.

B1L07-2-16.chinese: 今天天氣不冷也不熱，很舒服。
B1L07-2-16.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì bù lěng yě bù rè, hěn shūfu.
B1L07-2-16.english: Today's weather is neither cold nor hot; it's very comfortable.

B1L07-3-01.chinese: 我家附近有兩條捷運線。
B1L07-3-01.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu liǎng tiáo jiéyùn xiàn.
B1L07-3-01.english: There are two MRT lines near my home.

B1L07-3-04.chinese: 我明天早上九點要到機場。
B1L07-3-04.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn yào dào jīchǎng.
B1L07-3-04.english: I need to arrive at the airport at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.

B1L07-3-06.chinese: 那位司機開車開得很好。
B1L07-3-06.pinyin: Nà wèi sījī kāichē kāi de hěn hǎo.

B1L07-3-07.chinese: 在這個大車站，坐公車、捷運、火車都很方便。
B1L07-3-07.pinyin: Zài zhège dà chēzhàn, zuò gōngchē, jiéyùn, huǒchē dōu hěn fāngbiàn.
B1L07-3-07.english: At this big station, taking the bus, MRT, or train is all very convenient.

B1L07-3-08.pinyin: Nǐ jiā fùjìn yǒu jiéyùn zhàn ma?
B1L07-3-08.english: Is there an MRT station near your home?

B1L07-3-09.pinyin: Wǒ yào zuò fēijī dào Yīngguó qù.
B1L07-3-09.english: I want to take an airplane to England.

B1L07-3-11.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎoniǎo huì fēi ma?

B1L07-3-12.english: Look, the airplane has taken off!

B1L08-1-01.chinese: 我不太喜歡這條裙子的顏色。
B1L08-1-01.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān zhè tiáo qúnzi de yánsè.
B1L08-1-01.english: I don't really like the color of this skirt.

B1L08-1-04.chinese: 去年她送我一本書，今年我要送她一件衣服。
B1L08-1-04.pinyin: Qùnián tā sòng wǒ yī běn shū, jīnnián wǒ yào sòng tā yī jiàn yīfu.
B1L08-1-04.english: Last year she gave me a book; this year I want to give her a piece of clothing.

B1L08-1-06.chinese: 這個牌子的衣服又便宜又好看。
B1L08-1-06.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yīfu yòu piányi yòu hǎokàn.
B1L08-1-06.english: Clothes of this brand are both cheap and good-looking.

B1L08-1-07.chinese: 今天大家都穿很多衣服，因為天氣太冷了。
B1L08-1-07.pinyin: Jīntiān dàjiā dōu chuān hěn duō yīfu, yīnwèi tiānqì tài lěng le.
B1L08-1-07.english: Today everyone is wearing a lot of clothes because the weather is too cold.

B1L08-1-08.chinese: 這家餐廳很有名，我們常常來這裡吃飯。
B1L08-1-08.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn yǒumíng, wǒmen chángcháng lái zhèlǐ chīfàn.
B1L08-1-08.english: This restaurant is very famous; we often come here to eat.

B1L08-1-09.chinese: 那個牌子的褲子都不便宜。
B1L08-1-09.pinyin: Nàge páizi de kùzi dōu bù piányi.
B1L08-1-09.english: The pants of that brand are all not cheap.

B1L08-1-10.chinese: A:為什麼你不吃冰淇淋？ B:因為天氣有點兒冷，所以我想吃一點兒熱的。
B1L08-1-10.pinyin: A: Wèishénme nǐ bù chī bīngqílín? B: Yīnwèi tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng chī yīdiǎnr rè de.
B1L08-1-10.english: A: Why don't you eat ice cream? B: Because the weather is a little cold, so I want to eat something a little hot.

B1L08-1-11.chinese: A:為什麼你不吃冰淇淋？ B:因為天氣有點兒冷，所以我想吃一點兒熱的。
B1L08-1-11.pinyin: A: Wèishénme nǐ bù chī bīngqílín? B: Yīnwèi tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng chī yīdiǎnr rè de.
B1L08-1-11.english: A: Why don't you eat ice cream? B: Because the weather is a little cold, so I want to eat something a little hot.

B1L08-1-12.chinese: 我家附近有百貨公司，你想去看嗎？
B1L08-1-12.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu bǎihuò gōngsī, nǐ xiǎng qù kàn ma?
B1L08-1-12.english: There is a department store near my home; do you want to go take a look?

B1L08-1-13.chinese: 說中文容易，唱中文歌也不難。
B1L08-1-13.pinyin: Shuō Zhōngwén róngyì, chàng Zhōngwén gē yě bù nán.
B1L08-1-13.english: Speaking Chinese is easy, and singing Chinese songs is not difficult either.

B1L08-1-14.chinese: 說中文容易，唱中文歌也不難。
B1L08-1-14.pinyin: Shuō Zhōngwén róngyì, chàng Zhōngwén gē yě bù nán.
B1L08-1-14.english: Speaking Chinese is easy, and singing Chinese songs is not difficult either.

B1L08-1-15.chinese: 他最近很忙，所以每天都很累。
B1L08-1-15.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn hěn máng, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu hěn lèi.
B1L08-1-15.english: He has been very busy recently, so he is very tired every day.

B1L08-1-17.chinese: 因為他每天都跑步，所以瘦了。
B1L08-1-17.pinyin: Yīnwèi tā měitiān dōu pǎobù, suǒyǐ shòu le.
B1L08-1-17.english: Because he runs every day, he has become thin.

B1L08-1-20.chinese: 爸爸很喜歡吃蛋糕，所以胖了三公斤。
B1L08-1-20.pinyin: Bàba hěn xǐhuān chī dàngāo, suǒyǐ pàng le sān gōngjīn.
B1L08-1-20.english: Dad really likes eating cake, so he has gained three kilograms.

B1L08-1-22.chinese: 弟弟不喜歡唱歌，因為怕唱得不好。
B1L08-1-22.pinyin: Dìdi bù xǐhuān chànggē, yīnwèi pà chàng de bù hǎo.
B1L08-1-22.english: My younger brother doesn't like singing because he is afraid of singing badly.

B1L08-1-23.chinese: 他最近常常跟朋友一起玩。
B1L08-1-23.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn chángcháng gēn péngyǒu yīqǐ wán.
B1L08-1-23.english: He often hangs out with friends recently.

B1L08-1-24.chinese: 我最近沒有時間看電影。
B1L08-1-24.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn méiyǒu shíjiān kàn diànyǐng.
B1L08-1-24.english: I don't have time to watch movies recently.

B1L08-2-02.chinese: 姊姊喜歡穿黃色的裙子。
B1L08-2-02.pinyin: Jiějie xǐhuān chuān huángsè de qúnzi.
B1L08-2-02.english: My older sister likes to wear yellow skirts.

B1L08-2-03.chinese: 好多人來這家店買蛋糕，他們的蛋糕一定很好吃吧？
B1L08-2-03.pinyin: Hǎo duō rén lái zhè jiā diàn mǎi dàngāo, tāmen de dàngāo yīdìng hěn hǎochī ba?
B1L08-2-03.english: Many people come to this shop to buy cakes; their cakes must be very delicious, right?

B1L08-2-04.chinese: 白色是今年很流行的顏色。
B1L08-2-04.pinyin: Báisè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
B1L08-2-04.english: White is a very popular color this year.

B1L08-2-06.chinese: 弟弟愛穿短褲，不愛穿長褲。
B1L08-2-06.pinyin: Dìdi ài chuān duǎnkù, bù ài chuān chángkù.
B1L08-2-06.english: My younger brother loves to wear shorts, not long pants.

B1L08-2-11.chinese: 我想買一雙黑色的鞋子和一雙白色的襪子。
B1L08-2-11.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng hēisè de xiézi hé yī shuāng báisè de wàzi.
B1L08-2-11.english: I want to buy a pair of black shoes and a pair of white socks.

B1L08-2-12.english: Which floor is your home on?

B1L08-2-14.chinese: A:你要不要去樓下的客廳看電視？ B:謝謝，我想先去樓上的房間休息。
B1L08-2-14.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào qù lóuxià de kètīng kàn diànshì? B: Xièxie, wǒ xiǎng xiān qù lóushàng de fángjiān xiūxi.
B1L08-2-14.english: A: Do you want to go to the living room downstairs to watch TV? B: Thanks, I want to go to the room upstairs to rest first.

B1L08-2-16.chinese: 十點了，飛機快(要)起飛了。
B1L08-2-16.pinyin: Shí diǎn le, fēijī kuài (yào) qǐfēi le.
B1L08-2-16.english: It's ten o'clock; the plane is about to take off.

B1L08-2-18.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
B1L08-2-18.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
B1L08-2-18.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

B1L08-2-20.chinese: 我要坐電梯，不要走樓梯。
B1L08-2-20.pinyin: Wǒ yào zuò diàntī, bù yào zǒu lóutī.
B1L08-2-20.english: I want to take the elevator, not walk the stairs.

B1L08-2-23.chinese: A:我要去三樓找友美？ B:好。對了，這杯咖啡請你給她，好嗎？
B1L08-2-23.pinyin: A: Wǒ yào qù sān lóu zhǎo Yǒuměi? B: Hǎo. Duìle, zhè bēi kāfēi qǐng nǐ gěi tā, hǎo ma?
B1L08-2-23.english: A: I'm going to the third floor to look for Yumi? B: Okay. By the way, please give her this cup of coffee, okay?

B1L08-3-01.chinese: 很多年輕人喜歡聽流行音樂。
B1L08-3-01.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng rén xǐhuān tīng liúxíng yīnyuè.
B1L08-3-01.english: Many young people like to listen to popular music.

B1L08-3-03.chinese: 明天我有空，我想去買皮包。
B1L08-3-03.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yǒu kòng, wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi píbāo.
B1L08-3-03.english: Tomorrow I have free time; I want to go buy a wallet.

B1L08-3-05.chinese: 女生和男生都喜歡去百貨公司買東西。
B1L08-3-05.pinyin: Nǚshēng hé nánshēng dōu xǐhuān qù bǎihuò gōngsī mǎi dōngxi.
B1L08-3-05.english: Both girls and boys like to go to the department store to shop.

B1L08-3-07.chinese: 這本雜誌有點兒舊，我幫你買一本新的吧。
B1L08-3-07.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì yǒudiǎnr jiù, wǒ bāng nǐ mǎi yī běn xīn de ba.
B1L08-3-07.english: This magazine is a bit old; let me help you buy a new one.

B1L09-1-02.chinese: 這個句子的意思是什麼？妳知道嗎？
B1L09-1-02.pinyin: Zhège jùzi de yìsi shì shénme? Nǐ zhīdào ma?
B1L09-1-02.english: What is the meaning of this sentence? Do you know?

B1L09-1-03.chinese: 這些中文句子不難，我都懂。
B1L09-1-03.pinyin: Zhèxiē Zhōngwén jùzi bù nán, wǒ dōu dǒng.
B1L09-1-03.english: These Chinese sentences are not difficult; I understand them all.

B1L09-1-05.chinese: A:我妹妹說這件衣服很好看，你覺得呢？ B:這件衣服真的很好看！
B1L09-1-05.pinyin: A: Wǒ mèimei shuō zhè jiàn yīfu hěn hǎokàn, nǐ juéde ne? B: Zhè jiàn yīfu zhēn de hěn hǎokàn!
B1L09-1-05.english: A: My younger sister says this piece of clothing looks very nice; what do you think? B: This piece of clothing really looks very nice!

B1L09-1-06.chinese: 這個問題太難，我要去問老師。
B1L09-1-06.pinyin: Zhège wèntí tài nán, wǒ yào qù wèn lǎoshī.
B1L09-1-06.english: This question is too difficult; I need to go ask the teacher.

B1L09-1-07.chinese: 那條裙子很漂亮，可是非常貴。
B1L09-1-07.pinyin: Nà tiáo qúnzi hěn piàoliang, kěshì fēicháng guì.
B1L09-1-07.english: That skirt is very pretty, but it is very expensive.

B1L09-1-08.chinese: 我弟弟很聰明，學電腦學得非常快。
B1L09-1-08.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi hěn cōngmíng, xué diànnǎo xué de fēicháng kuài.
B1L09-1-08.english: My younger brother is very smart; he learns computer skills very quickly.

B1L09-1-09.chinese: 你不想坐公車，那(麼)我們坐計程車吧。
B1L09-1-09.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng zuò gōngchē, nà(me) wǒmen zuò jìchéngchē ba.
B1L09-1-09.english: You don't want to take the bus; then let's take a taxi.

B1L09-1-10.chinese: 你看，他們在跳舞，跳得真好看！
B1L09-1-10.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, tāmen zài tiàowǔ, tiào de zhēn hǎokàn!
B1L09-1-10.english: Look, they are dancing; they dance really beautifully!

B1L09-1-12.chinese: 我明天要上書法課，現在要去買毛筆！
B1L09-1-12.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào shàng shūfǎ kè, xiànzài yào qù mǎi máobǐ!
B1L09-1-12.english: I have calligraphy class tomorrow; I need to go buy a writing brush now!

B1L09-1-13.pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi, xiǎng huí sùshè xiūxi!
B1L09-1-13.english: I am very tired; I want to go back to the dorm to rest!

B1L09-1-15.chinese: 中文老師每天都給我們作業。
B1L09-1-15.pinyin: Zhōngwén lǎoshī měi tiān dōu gěi wǒmen zuòyè.
B1L09-1-15.english: The Chinese teacher gives us homework every day.

B1L09-1-16.chinese: 我要先回家，再去圖書館。
B1L09-1-16.pinyin: Wǒ yào xiān huí jiā, zài qù túshūguǎn.
B1L09-1-16.english: I want to go home first, then go to the library.

B1L09-2-01.chinese: 那家咖啡廳在郵局對面。
B1L09-2-01.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēitīng zài yóujú duìmiàn.
B1L09-2-01.english: That coffee shop is across from the post office.

B1L09-2-02.chinese: 我媽媽的花店在百貨公司和超級市場中間。
B1L09-2-02.pinyin: Wǒ māma de huādiàn zài bǎihuò gōngsī hé chāojí shìchǎng zhōngjiān.
B1L09-2-02.english: My mother's flower shop is between the department store and the supermarket.

B1L09-2-03.chinese: 他不在教室裡上課，那他在哪裡？
B1L09-2-03.pinyin: Tā bù zài jiàoshì lǐ shàngkè, nà tā zài nǎlǐ?
B1L09-2-03.english: He is not in the classroom having class, so where is he?

B1L09-2-04.chinese: 我現在有課，不能去他家。
B1L09-2-04.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài yǒu kè, bù néng qù tā jiā.
B1L09-2-04.english: I have class now, so I cannot go to his house.

B1L09-2-05.chinese: 我不太會用這個牌子的電腦，你可以教我嗎？
B1L09-2-05.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài huì yòng zhège páizi de diànnǎo, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
B1L09-2-05.english: I don't really know how to use this brand of computer; can you teach me?

B1L09-2-06.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yǒu shí ge xuésheng.

B1L09-2-07.chinese: 這個禮拜我有很多功課，不能跟你去玩。
B1L09-2-07.pinyin: Zhège lǐbài wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōngkè, bù néng gēn nǐ qù wán.
B1L09-2-07.english: This week I have a lot of homework, so I cannot go out and have fun with you.

B1L09-2-08.pinyin: Nǐ huì shuō jǐ zhǒng yǔyán?
B1L09-2-08.english: How many languages can you speak?

B1L09-2-09.chinese: 我只想喝茶，別的飲料我都不想喝。
B1L09-2-09.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng hē chá, bié de yǐnliào wǒ dōu bù xiǎng hē.
B1L09-2-09.english: I only want to drink tea; I don't want to drink any other beverages.

B1L09-2-10.pinyin: Zhèlǐ zhǐ yǒu wǒ, méiyǒu biérén.
B1L09-2-10.english: There is only me here; there are no others.

B1L09-2-11.chinese: 最近天氣比較熱，我不常去運動。
B1L09-2-11.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bǐjiào rè, wǒ bù cháng qù yùndòng.
B1L09-2-11.english: Recently the weather is relatively hot, so I don't often go exercise.

B1L09-2-12.chinese: 她明天也許有空，我們可以請她一起來喝咖啡。
B1L09-2-12.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yěxǔ yǒu kòng, wǒmen kěyǐ qǐng tā yìqǐ lái hē kāfēi.
B1L09-2-12.english: She might be free tomorrow; we can invite her to come have coffee together.

B1L09-2-13.chinese: 我希望明年可以去英國學英文。
B1L09-2-13.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng míngnián kěyǐ qù Yīngguó xué Yīngwén.
B1L09-2-13.english: I hope to go to England to study English next year.

B1L09-3-02.chinese: 新學期快要開始了。我們每天八點四十分開始上課。
B1L09-3-02.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī kuài yào kāishǐ le. Wǒmen měi tiān bā diǎn sìshí fēn kāishǐ shàngkè.
B1L09-3-02.english: The new semester is about to start. We start class at 8:40 every day.

B1L09-3-03.pinyin: Nǐ juéde Huáyǔ hǎo xué ma?
B1L09-3-03.english: Do you think Chinese is easy to learn?

B1L09-3-04.chinese: 我每天下午一點開始寫功課。
B1L09-3-04.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān xiàwǔ yì diǎn kāishǐ xiě gōngkè.
B1L09-3-04.english: I start writing homework at 1 p.m. every day.

B1L09-3-06.chinese: 我常常跟日本朋友練習說日文。
B1L09-3-06.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng gēn Rìběn péngyǒu liànxí shuō Rìwén.
B1L09-3-06.english: I often practice speaking Japanese with Japanese friends.

B1L09-3-09.chinese: 姐姐每天晚上都讀書，她進步了很多。
B1L09-3-09.pinyin: Jiějie měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, tā jìnbù le hěn duō.
B1L09-3-09.english: My older sister studies every evening; she has improved a lot.

B1L09-3-10.chinese: 聽說下星期一我們要用別的教室，你知道是哪間教室嗎？
B1L09-3-10.pinyin: Tīngshuō xià xīngqīyī wǒmen yào yòng bié de jiàoshì, nǐ zhīdào shì nǎ jiān jiàoshì ma?
B1L09-3-10.english: I heard that next Monday we will use a different classroom; do you know which classroom it is?

B1L09-3-12.chinese: 我不懂他的意思，不知道應該說什麼，所以有點兒緊張。
B1L09-3-12.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng tā de yìsi, bù zhīdào yīnggāi shuō shénme, suǒyǐ yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng.
B1L09-3-12.english: I don't understand what he means and don't know what I should say, so I am a bit nervous.

B1L09-3-13.chinese: 我會寫三百多個中國字。
B1L09-3-13.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiě sānbǎi duō ge Zhōngguó zì.
B1L09-3-13.english: I can write more than three hundred Chinese characters.

B1L09-3-14.chinese: 明天要考試，每個學生都很緊張。今天的考試不難，大家都考得不錯。
B1L09-3-14.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎoshì, měi ge xuésheng dōu hěn jǐnzhāng. Jīntiān de kǎoshì bù nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de búcuò.
B1L09-3-14.english: There will be an exam tomorrow, so every student is very nervous. Today's exam was not difficult; everyone did pretty well on the test.

B1L09-3-15.chinese: 老師明天要考三十個中國字，我應該開始練習了。
B1L09-3-15.pinyin: Lǎoshī míngtiān yào kǎo sānshí ge Zhōngguó zì, wǒ yīnggāi kāishǐ liànxí le.
B1L09-3-15.english: The teacher will test thirty Chinese characters tomorrow, so I should start practicing.

B1L10-1-01.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng zài jiā xiūxi.
B1L10-1-01.english: I caught a cold, and I want to rest at home.

B1L10-1-03.pinyin: Dìdi fāshāo le, tā yào qǐngjià.
B1L10-1-03.english: My younger brother has a fever, and he needs to ask for leave.

B1L10-1-05.chinese: 他跟我說，他感冒了，要去看醫生。
B1L10-1-05.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ shuō, tā gǎnmào le, yào qù kàn yīshēng.
B1L10-1-05.english: He said to me that he caught a cold and needs to go see a doctor.

B1L10-1-10.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，你要戴口罩、常洗手。
B1L10-1-10.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, nǐ yào dài kǒuzhào, cháng xǐ shǒu.
B1L10-1-10.english: Recently many people have caught colds; you should wear a mask and wash your hands often.

B1L10-1-13.chinese: 我爸爸很健康，不常生病。
B1L10-1-13.pinyin: Wǒ bàba hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
B1L10-1-13.english: My dad is very healthy and doesn't often get sick.

B1L10-1-15.chinese: 他說：「你唱得很好。」這個中文句子對嗎？
B1L10-1-15.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ chàng de hěn hǎo.” Zhège Zhōngwén jùzi duì ma?
B1L10-1-15.english: He said, “You sing very well.” Is this Chinese sentence correct?

B1L10-1-17.chinese: 我最近太胖了，應該多運動，少吃一點飯。
B1L10-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tài pàng le, yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yīdiǎn fàn.
B1L10-1-17.english: I've gotten too fat recently; I should exercise more and eat a little less food.

B1L10-1-18.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，大家應該注意身體健康。
B1L10-1-18.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, dàjiā yīnggāi zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
B1L10-1-18.english: Recently many people have caught colds; everyone should pay attention to their body's health.

B1L10-1-19.chinese: 明天有書法課，我要帶毛筆去學校。
B1L10-1-19.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu shūfǎ kè, wǒ yào dài máobǐ qù xuéxiào.
B1L10-1-19.english: Tomorrow there is calligraphy class; I need to bring a brush to school.

B1L10-1-21.pinyin: Wǒ zuì ài chī píngguǒ gēn xiāngjiāo.
B1L10-1-21.english: I love eating apples and bananas the most.

B1L10-2-01.chinese: 我昨天開始咳嗽，現在想去看醫生。
B1L10-2-01.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān kāishǐ késòu, xiànzài xiǎng qù kàn yīshēng.
B1L10-2-01.english: I started to cough yesterday, and now I want to go see a doctor.

B1L10-2-09.chinese: 我感冒了，頭很痛，眼睛、耳朵也不舒服。
B1L10-2-09.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, tóu hěn tòng, yǎnjing, ěrduo yě bù shūfu.
B1L10-2-09.english: I caught a cold; my head hurts a lot, and my eyes and ears are also uncomfortable.

B1L10-2-10.chinese: 這個孩子眼睛不太好，所以每天都戴眼鏡。
B1L10-2-10.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǎnjing bù tài hǎo, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu dài yǎnjìng.
B1L10-2-10.english: This child's eyes are not very good, so he wears glasses every day.

B1L10-2-11.chinese: 我肚子餓了，想吃點兒東西。
B1L10-2-11.pinyin: Wǒ dùzi è le, xiǎng chī diǎnr dōngxi.
B1L10-2-11.english: My belly is hungry; I want to eat something.

B1L10-2-12.chinese: 這張椅子不太乾淨，我要那張。
B1L10-2-12.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yǐzi bù tài gānjìng, wǒ yào nà zhāng.
B1L10-2-12.english: This chair is not very clean; I want that one.

B1L10-2-13.chinese: 每個人都需要朋友。我累了，需要回家休息。
B1L10-2-13.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu xūyào péngyǒu. Wǒ lèi le, xūyào huí jiā xiūxi.
B1L10-2-13.english: Everyone needs friends. I'm tired and need to go home to rest.

B1L10-2-14.chinese: 醫生說，我應該多喝水，不需要吃藥。
B1L10-2-14.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, bù xūyào chī yào.
B1L10-2-14.english: The doctor said I should drink more water and don't need to take medicine.

B1L10-2-15.chinese: 他明天沒有空，不會來我們家。
B1L10-2-15.pinyin: Tā míngtiān méiyǒu kòng, bù huì lái wǒmen jiā.
B1L10-2-15.english: He is not free tomorrow and will not come to our house.

B1L10-2-16.chinese: 我只記得明天有考試，不記得有功課。
B1L10-2-16.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ jìde míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, bù jìde yǒu gōngkè.
B1L10-2-16.english: I only remember that there is an exam tomorrow; I don't remember that there is homework.

B1L10-2-18.chinese: 如果明天天氣好，我就去打球。
B1L10-2-18.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒ jiù qù dǎ qiú.
B1L10-2-18.english: If the weather is good tomorrow, then I will go play ball.

B1L10-2-19.chinese: 我身體不舒服，所以不能跟你們去打球。
B1L10-2-19.pinyin: Wǒ shēntǐ bù shūfu, suǒyǐ bù néng gēn nǐmen qù dǎ qiú.
B1L10-2-19.english: I am not feeling well, so I cannot go play ball with you.

B1L10-3-02.chinese: 我打電話去他家，可是沒人接電話。
B1L10-3-02.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà qù tā jiā, kěshì méi rén jiē diànhuà.
B1L10-3-02.english: I called his house, but no one answered the phone.

B1L10-3-04.chinese: 你記不記得張老師的電話號碼？
B1L10-3-04.pinyin: Nǐ jì bù jìde Zhāng lǎoshī de diànhuà hàomǎ?
B1L10-3-04.english: Do you remember Teacher Zhang's phone number?

B1L10-3-05.chinese: 國安發燒了，不能來上課，我有點兒擔心他。
B1L10-3-05.pinyin: Guó'ān fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè, wǒ yǒudiǎnr dānxīn tā.
B1L10-3-05.english: Guo'an has a fever and cannot come to class; I am a little worried about him.

B1L10-3-07.chinese: 媽媽告訴我，不要忘記去超級市場買飲料。
B1L10-3-07.pinyin: Māma gàosu wǒ, bùyào wàngjì qù chāojí shìchǎng mǎi yǐnliào.
B1L10-3-07.english: Mom told me not to forget to go to the supermarket to buy drinks.

B1L10-3-08.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
B1L10-3-08.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
B1L10-3-08.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

B1L11-1-01.chinese: 我上個禮拜認識了一位中文老師。
B1L11-1-01.pinyin: Wǒ shàng ge lǐbài rènshi le yí wèi Zhōngwén lǎoshī.
B1L11-1-01.english: Last week I got to know a Chinese teacher.

B1L11-1-02.chinese: 我昨天跟朋友說了很多話，我們都很開心。
B1L11-1-02.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou shuō le hěn duō huà, wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
B1L11-1-02.english: Yesterday I said a lot to my friend, and we were both very happy.

B1L11-1-03.chinese: A:你寫功課了嗎？ B:我已經寫了。
B1L11-1-03.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiě gōngkè le ma? B: Wǒ yǐjīng xiě le.
B1L11-1-03.english: A: Have you done your homework? B: I have already done it.

B1L11-1-04.chinese: 這是我朋友送我的生日卡片。
B1L11-1-04.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou sòng wǒ de shēngrì kǎpiàn.
B1L11-1-04.english: This is the birthday card my friend gave me.

B1L11-1-05.chinese: 我常常在電視上看到那位有名的醫生。
B1L11-1-05.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài diànshì shàng kàndào nà wèi yǒumíng de yīshēng.
B1L11-1-05.english: I often see that famous doctor on TV.

B1L11-1-06.chinese: 他寫的文章都很有趣，我很喜歡看。
B1L11-1-06.pinyin: Tā xiě de wénzhāng dōu hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuan kàn.
B1L11-1-06.english: The articles he writes are all very interesting; I really like reading them.

B1L11-1-07.chinese: 我們先游泳，然後再去吃飯，好不好？
B1L11-1-07.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān yóuyǒng, ránhòu zài qù chīfàn, hǎo bu hǎo?
B1L11-1-07.english: Let's swim first, and then go eat, okay?

B1L11-1-08.chinese: 如果他不能接電話，你就留言吧！
B1L11-1-08.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā bù néng jiē diànhuà, nǐ jiù liúyán ba!
B1L11-1-08.english: If he can't answer the phone, then leave a message!

B1L11-1-09.chinese: 我不知道怎麼回答他的問題。
B1L11-1-09.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme huídá tā de wèntí.
B1L11-1-09.english: I don't know how to answer his question.

B1L11-1-10.chinese: 他說話很有趣，所以每個人都喜歡跟他聊天。
B1L11-1-10.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒuqù, suǒyǐ měi ge rén dōu xǐhuan gēn tā liáotiān.
B1L11-1-10.english: He speaks interestingly, so everyone likes to chat with him.

B1L11-1-11.chinese: A:你每天幾點起床？ B:差不多七點。
B1L11-1-11.pinyin: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng? B: Chàbuduō qī diǎn.
B1L11-1-11.english: A: What time do you get up every day? B: About seven o'clock.

B1L11-1-12.chinese: 你們在聊什麼？聊得好開心。
B1L11-1-12.pinyin: Nǐmen zài liáo shénme? Liáo de hǎo kāixīn.
B1L11-1-12.english: What are you chatting about? You're chatting so happily.

B1L11-1-13.chinese: 你這個週末有空嗎？ 我想跟你見面。
B1L11-1-13.pinyin: Nǐ zhège zhōumò yǒu kòng ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn.
B1L11-1-13.english: Are you free this weekend? I want to meet with you.

B1L11-1-14.chinese: A:你現在要回宿舍嗎？ B:還沒，我要先去吃飯再回宿舍。
B1L11-1-14.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yào huí sùshè ma? B: Hái méi, wǒ yào xiān qù chīfàn zài huí sùshè.
B1L11-1-14.english: A: Are you going back to the dorm now? B: Not yet; I want to go eat first and then go back to the dorm.

B1L11-1-15.chinese: 他上個禮拜生病了，現在還在咳嗽。
B1L11-1-15.pinyin: Tā shàng ge lǐbài shēngbìng le, xiànzài hái zài késou.
B1L11-1-15.english: He got sick last week, and he is still coughing now.

B1L11-1-16.chinese: A:昨天你去運動了嗎 ？ B:我沒去運動，我去朋友家玩。
B1L11-1-16.pinyin: A: Zuótiān nǐ qù yùndòng le ma? B: Wǒ méi qù yùndòng, wǒ qù péngyou jiā wán.
B1L11-1-16.english: A: Did you go exercise yesterday? B: I didn't go exercise; I went to a friend's house to have fun.

B1L11-1-17.chinese: A:你已經決定明年去英國了嗎？ B:我還沒做決定。
B1L11-1-17.pinyin: A: Nǐ yǐjīng juédìng míngnián qù Yīngguó le ma? B: Wǒ hái méi zuò juédìng.
B1L11-1-17.english: A: Have you already decided to go to England next year? B: I haven't made a decision yet.

B1L11-2-01.chinese: 以前妹妹很不喜歡穿裙子，現在她覺得穿裙子很舒服。
B1L11-2-01.pinyin: Yǐqián mèimei hěn bù xǐhuan chuān qúnzi, xiànzài tā juéde chuān qúnzi hěn shūfu.
B1L11-2-01.english: In the past, my younger sister really didn't like wearing skirts; now she feels that wearing skirts is very comfortable.

B1L11-2-02.chinese: 我希望以後可以去他家玩。
B1L11-2-02.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng yǐhòu kěyǐ qù tā jiā wán.
B1L11-2-02.english: I hope that in the future I can go to his house to have fun.

B1L11-2-03.chinese: 你可以告訴我學中文的經驗嗎？
B1L11-2-03.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gàosu wǒ xué Zhōngwén de jīngyàn ma?
B1L11-2-03.english: Can you tell me about your experience learning Chinese?

B1L11-2-04.chinese: 這家餐廳賣很多蛋糕和冰淇淋，這樣的甜點我都很喜歡。
B1L11-2-04.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài hěn duō dàngāo hé bīngqílín, zhèyàng de tiándiǎn wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
B1L11-2-04.english: This restaurant sells many cakes and ice cream; I like desserts like this very much.

B1L11-2-05.chinese: 老師為什麼還沒來？大家都覺得很奇怪。
B1L11-2-05.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèishénme hái méi lái? Dàjiā dōu juéde hěn qíguài.
B1L11-2-05.english: Why hasn't the teacher come yet? Everyone feels it's very strange.

B1L11-2-06.chinese: 這個孩子飯吃得太少了，你有什麼好辦法？
B1L11-2-06.pinyin: Zhège háizi fàn chī de tài shǎo le, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ?
B1L11-2-06.english: This child eats too little food; do you have any good method?

B1L11-2-07.chinese: 可以請你幫我一個忙嗎？
B1L11-2-07.pinyin: Kěyǐ qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ yí ge máng ma?
B1L11-2-07.english: Can I ask you to help me with a favor?

B1L11-2-08.chinese: 他打算坐捷運去跟朋友見面。
B1L11-2-08.pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn zuò jiéyùn qù gēn péngyǒu jiànmiàn.
B1L11-2-08.english: He plans to take the MRT to meet a friend.

B1L11-2-09.chinese: 我打電話給她，她沒接，可能在睡覺。
B1L11-2-09.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi tā, tā méi jiē, kěnéng zài shuìjiào.
B1L11-2-09.english: I called her, she didn't answer; she's probably sleeping.

B1L11-2-10.chinese: 週末我有空，要約朋友一起去玩。
B1L11-2-10.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ yǒu kòng, yào yuē péngyǒu yìqǐ qù wán.
B1L11-2-10.english: I'm free this weekend; I want to make an appointment with friends to go out and have fun together.

B1L11-2-11.chinese: 這個香蕉蛋糕不好看，但是很好吃。
B1L11-2-11.pinyin: Zhège xiāngjiāo dàngāo bù hǎokàn, dànshì hěn hǎochī.
B1L11-2-11.english: This banana cake doesn't look good, but it's very tasty.

B1L11-2-12.chinese: 我感冒了，想給老師打電話，跟他說我不能去上課。
B1L11-2-12.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà, gēn tā shuō wǒ bù néng qù shàngkè.
B1L11-2-12.english: I caught a cold; I want to call the teacher to tell him I can't go to class.

B1L11-2-13.chinese: A:你什麼時候有空？要不要跟我去唱歌？ B:我今天下午有空。
B1L11-2-13.pinyin: A: Nǐ shénme shíhou yǒu kòng? Yào bú yào gēn wǒ qù chànggē? B: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng.
B1L11-2-13.english: A: When are you free? Do you want to go sing with me? B: I'm free this afternoon.

B1L11-3-01.chinese: 我常在網路上聽我喜歡的音樂。
B1L11-3-01.pinyin: Wǒ cháng zài wǎnglù shàng tīng wǒ xǐhuān de yīnyuè.
B1L11-3-01.english: I often listen to music I like on the internet.

B1L11-3-02.chinese: A:請問你們有英文菜單嗎？ B:對不起，我們沒有。
B1L11-3-02.pinyin: A: Qǐngwèn nǐmen yǒu Yīngwén càidān ma? B: Duìbuqǐ, wǒmen méiyǒu.
B1L11-3-02.english: A: Excuse me, do you have an English menu? B: Sorry, we don't.

B1L11-3-03.chinese: 這家餐廳很特別，沒有菜單。
B1L11-3-03.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn tèbié, méiyǒu càidān.
B1L11-3-03.english: This restaurant is very special; it doesn't have a menu.

B1L11-3-05.chinese: A:我們要點幾盤菜？ B:今天是你的生日，我們多點幾盤吧。
B1L11-3-05.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào diǎn jǐ pán cài? B: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, wǒmen duō diǎn jǐ pán ba.
B1L11-3-05.english: A: How many dishes shall we order? B: Today is your birthday; let's order a few more dishes.

B1L11-3-06.chinese: 這幾盤菜都是我媽媽做的。
B1L11-3-06.pinyin: Zhè jǐ pán cài dōu shì wǒ māma zuò de.
B1L11-3-06.english: These few plates of dishes are all made by my mom.

B1L11-3-07.chinese: 這幾盤菜都是我媽媽做的。
B1L11-3-07.pinyin: Zhè jǐ pán cài dōu shì wǒ māma zuò de.
B1L11-3-07.english: These few plates of dishes are all made by my mom.

B1L11-3-08.chinese: 我弟弟很喜歡幫人照相。
B1L11-3-08.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi hěn xǐhuān bāng rén zhàoxiàng.
B1L11-3-08.english: My younger brother really likes to help people take photos.

B1L11-3-09.chinese: 我弟弟很喜歡幫人照相。
B1L11-3-09.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi hěn xǐhuān bāng rén zhàoxiàng.
B1L11-3-09.english: My younger brother really likes to help people take photos.

B1L11-3-10.chinese: A:這個照相機是誰的？ B:是我爸爸的。
B1L11-3-10.pinyin: A: Zhège zhàoxiàngjī shì shéi de? B: Shì wǒ bàba de.
B1L11-3-10.english: A: Whose camera is this? B: It's my dad's.

B1L11-3-11.chinese: A:這些相片是在哪裡照的？ B:花蓮。
B1L11-3-11.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē xiàngpiàn shì zài nǎlǐ zhào de? B: Huālián.
B1L11-3-11.english: A: Where were these photos taken? B: Hualien.

B1L11-3-12.chinese: A:你今天唱歌唱得真好聽？ B:因為我心情很好。
B1L11-3-12.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān chànggē chàng de zhēn hǎotīng? B: Yīnwèi wǒ xīnqíng hěn hǎo.
B1L11-3-12.english: A: You sang really beautifully today! B: Because I'm in a very good mood.

B1L11-3-13.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
B1L11-3-13.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
B1L11-3-13.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

B1L11-3-14.chinese: 我有一些台灣朋友，所以說中文的機會很多。
B1L11-3-14.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yìxiē Táiwān péngyǒu, suǒyǐ shuō Zhōngwén de jīhuì hěn duō.
B1L11-3-14.english: I have some Taiwanese friends, so I have many chances to speak Chinese.

B1L12-1-01.chinese: 我爸爸是老師，他很喜歡他的工作。他在餐廳工作，每天差不多都晚上十點回家。
B1L12-1-01.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān tā de gōngzuò. Tā zài cāntīng gōngzuò, měitiān chàbuduō dōu wǎnshàng shí diǎn huí jiā.
B1L12-1-01.english: My dad is a teacher; he really likes his job. He works at a restaurant, and he almost always gets home around ten at night every day.

B1L12-1-02.chinese: A:今天天氣很好，你怎麼沒出去？ B:今天我有很多功課，不能出去玩。
B1L12-1-02.pinyin: A: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, nǐ zěnme méi chūqù? B: Jīntiān wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōngkè, bù néng chūqù wán.
B1L12-1-02.english: A: The weather is so nice today; how come you didn't go out? B: I have a lot of homework today, so I can't go out and have fun.

B1L12-1-03.chinese: 你要參加學校的游泳比賽嗎？
B1L12-1-03.pinyin: Nǐ yào cānjiā xuéxiào de yóuyǒng bǐsài ma?
B1L12-1-03.english: Are you going to participate in the school's swimming competition?

B1L12-1-04.chinese: A:你覺得我可以當老師嗎？ B:如果你想當，一定有機會。
B1L12-1-04.pinyin: A: Nǐ juéde wǒ kěyǐ dāng lǎoshī ma? B: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dāng, yídìng yǒu jīhuì.
B1L12-1-04.english: A: Do you think I can be a teacher? B: If you want to be one, you'll definitely have a chance.

B1L12-1-05.chinese: 我姊姊是這家醫院的護理師。
B1L12-1-05.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie shì zhè jiā yīyuàn de hùlǐshī.
B1L12-1-05.english: My older sister is a nurse at this hospital.

B1L12-1-06.chinese: 我常常用中文給台灣朋友寫信。
B1L12-1-06.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng yòng Zhōngwén gěi Táiwān péngyǒu xiě xìn.
B1L12-1-06.english: I often write letters to Taiwanese friends in Chinese.

B1L12-1-07.chinese: 我覺得當記者不容易，週末常常不能休息。
B1L12-1-07.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dāng jìzhě bù róngyì, zhōumò chángcháng bù néng xiūxí.
B1L12-1-07.english: I think being a reporter is not easy; often I can't rest on weekends.

B1L12-1-09.chinese: 哥哥畢業了，下個月要去銀行工作。
B1L12-1-09.pinyin: Gēge bìyè le, xià ge yuè yào qù yínháng gōngzuò.
B1L12-1-09.english: My older brother has graduated; next month he will go to work at a bank.

B1L12-1-10.chinese: 考試開始以後，我們不可以跟同學說話。
B1L12-1-10.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ yǐhòu, wǒmen bù kěyǐ gēn tóngxué shuōhuà.
B1L12-1-10.english: After the exam starts, we cannot talk with classmates.

B1L12-1-11.chinese: 我去上課以前，一定會先在家吃早飯。
B1L12-1-11.pinyin: Wǒ qù shàngkè yǐqián, yídìng huì xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
B1L12-1-11.english: Before I go to class, I definitely will first eat breakfast at home.

B1L12-1-12.chinese: 我們公司附近有很多餐廳和飲料店。
B1L12-1-12.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī fùjìn yǒu hěn duō cāntīng hé yǐnliào diàn.
B1L12-1-12.english: Near our company there are many restaurants and beverage shops.

B1L12-1-13.chinese: 在台灣，很多年輕人喜歡當咖啡店的老闆。
B1L12-1-13.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, hěn duō niánqīngrén xǐhuān dāng kāfēi diàn de lǎobǎn.
B1L12-1-13.english: In Taiwan, many young people like to be the boss of a coffee shop.

B1L12-1-14.chinese: 這件事情，他已經告訴大家了。我今天做了很多事，現在累了，需要休息了。
B1L12-1-14.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng, tā yǐjīng gàosu dàjiā le. Wǒ jīntiān zuò le hěn duō shì, xiànzài lèi le, xūyào xiūxí le.
B1L12-1-14.english: This matter, he has already told everyone. Today I did many things; now I am tired and need to rest.

B1L12-1-16.chinese: 我們八點半開始上班，我每天都準時到公司。
B1L12-1-16.pinyin: Wǒmen bā diǎn bàn kāishǐ shàngbān, wǒ měi tiān dōu zhǔnshí dào gōngsī.
B1L12-1-16.english: We start work at 8:30; I arrive at the company on time every day.

B1L12-1-17.chinese: 下班以後，她常跟朋友一起去跑步。
B1L12-1-17.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, tā cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù pǎobù.
B1L12-1-17.english: After getting off work, she often goes running with friends.

B1L12-2-01.chinese: 那家有名的麵包店賣很多種麵包，都很好吃。
B1L12-2-01.pinyin: Nà jiā yǒumíng de miànbāo diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng miànbāo, dōu hěn hǎochī.
B1L12-2-01.english: That famous bakery sells many kinds of bread; all are delicious.

B1L12-2-02.chinese: 他每天早上去上班，晚上去上課，真辛苦！
B1L12-2-02.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù shàngbān, wǎnshang qù shàngkè, zhēn xīnkǔ!
B1L12-2-02.english: He goes to work every morning and goes to class in the evening; it's really tough!

B1L12-2-03.chinese: 這家飯店又方便又乾淨，而且不貴。
B1L12-2-03.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn yòu fāngbiàn yòu gānjìng, érqiě bú guì.
B1L12-2-03.english: This hotel is both convenient and clean, and moreover not expensive.

B1L12-2-04.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
B1L12-2-04.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
B1L12-2-04.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

B1L12-2-05.chinese: 如果我們對別人好，別人也會對我們好。
B1L12-2-05.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒmen duì biérén hǎo, biérén yě huì duì wǒmen hǎo.
B1L12-2-05.english: If we are good to others, others will also be good to us.

B1L12-2-06.chinese: 你這學期的成績進步了，太好了！
B1L12-2-06.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xuéqī de chéngjī jìnbù le, tài hǎo le!
B1L12-2-06.english: Your grades this semester have improved; that's great!

B1L12-2-07.chinese: 我還沒去過日本，今年可能有機會去。
B1L12-2-07.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi qù guo Rìběn, jīnnián kěnéng yǒu jīhuì qù.
B1L12-2-07.english: I have not yet been to Japan; this year I might have a chance to go.

B1L12-2-08.chinese: A:這些點心夠不夠？ B:夠了，夠了，我們已經吃過午飯了。
B1L12-2-08.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē diǎnxin gòu bu gòu? B: Gòu le, gòu le, wǒmen yǐjīng chī guo wǔfàn le.
B1L12-2-08.english: A: Are these snacks enough? B: Enough, enough; we have already eaten lunch.

B1L12-2-09.chinese: 他今天上班遲到了，老闆不太高興。
B1L12-2-09.pinyin: Tā jīntiān shàngbān chídào le, lǎobǎn bú tài gāoxìng.
B1L12-2-09.english: He was late for work today; the boss is not too happy.

B1L12-2-10.chinese: 今天是我的生日，媽媽準備了很多我愛吃的菜。
B1L12-2-10.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì, māma zhǔnbèi le hěn duō wǒ ài chī de cài.
B1L12-2-10.english: Today is my birthday; Mom prepared many dishes that I love to eat.

B1L12-2-11.chinese: 一個小時以前，他還在這裡。
B1L12-2-11.pinyin: Yí ge xiǎoshí yǐqián, tā hái zài zhèlǐ.
B1L12-2-11.english: An hour ago, he was still here.

B1L12-2-12.chinese: 十分鐘以前我給他打了一個電話。
B1L12-2-12.pinyin: Shí fēnzhōng yǐqián wǒ gěi tā dǎ le yí ge diànhuà.
B1L12-2-12.english: Ten minutes ago, I gave him a phone call.

B1L12-3-01.chinese: 最近有什麼好看的電視節目？
B1L12-3-01.pinyin: Zuìjìn yǒu shénme hǎokàn de diànshì jiémù?
B1L12-3-01.english: What good TV programs are there recently?

B1L12-3-02.chinese: 他的父母都在學校當老師。
B1L12-3-02.pinyin: Tā de fùmǔ dōu zài xuéxiào dāng lǎoshī.
B1L12-3-02.english: His parents both work as teachers at a school.

B1L12-3-03.chinese: 我父親文章寫得很好，而且他的字也很漂亮。
B1L12-3-03.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn wénzhāng xiě de hěn hǎo, érqiě tā de zì yě hěn piàoliang.
B1L12-3-03.english: My father writes articles very well, and moreover his handwriting is also very beautiful.

B1L12-3-04.chinese: 我的母親常對我說：「你要多看書，少玩手機。」
B1L12-3-04.pinyin: Wǒ de mǔqīn cháng duì wǒ shuō: “Nǐ yào duō kàn shū, shǎo wán shǒujī.”
B1L12-3-04.english: My mother often says to me: 'You should read more books and play less on your phone.'

B1L12-3-06.chinese: 李先生有三個孩子，一個兒子，兩個女兒。
B1L12-3-06.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng yǒu sān ge háizi, yí ge érzi, liǎng ge nǚ'ér.
B1L12-3-06.english: Mr. Li has three children: one son and two daughters.

B1L12-3-07.chinese: 現在我沒有時間，明天再跟你談這個問題。
B1L12-3-07.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān zài gēn nǐ tán zhège wèntí.
B1L12-3-07.english: I don't have time now; I'll talk about this issue with you tomorrow.

B1L12-3-08.chinese: 老闆要跟我們談話，想知道我們工作做得怎麼樣。
B1L12-3-08.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yào gēn wǒmen tánhuà, xiǎng zhīdào wǒmen gōngzuò zuò de zěnmeyàng.
B1L12-3-08.english: The boss wants to have a conversation with us; he wants to know how our work is going.

B1L12-3-09.chinese: 這件事情他自己可以做，不需要我們幫忙。
B1L12-3-09.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng tā zìjǐ kěyǐ zuò, bù xūyào wǒmen bāngmáng.
B1L12-3-09.english: He can do this matter himself; he doesn't need our help.

B1L12-3-11.chinese: 結婚以前，他覺得工作最重要，現在他覺得家人最重要。
B1L12-3-11.pinyin: Jiéhūn yǐqián, tā juéde gōngzuò zuì zhòngyào, xiànzài tā juéde jiārén zuì zhòngyào.
B1L12-3-11.english: Before getting married, he felt work was most important; now he feels family is most important.

B1L12-3-13.chinese: 今天辦公室的冷氣不冷，可能冷氣機有問題。
B1L12-3-13.pinyin: Jīntiān bàngōngshì de lěngqì bù lěng, kěnéng lěngqìjī yǒu wèntí.
B1L12-3-13.english: Today the air conditioning in the office is not cold; there might be a problem with the air conditioner.

B1L12-3-14.chinese: 在這家咖啡廳，可以上網還可以看雜誌。
B1L12-3-14.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā kāfēitīng, kěyǐ shàngwǎng hái kěyǐ kàn zázhì.
B1L12-3-14.english: At this café, you can go online and also read magazines.

B1L12-3-16.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
B1L12-3-16.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
B1L12-3-16.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

B1L13-1-01.chinese: 喂，請問王宜文小姐在嗎？
B1L13-1-01.pinyin: Wèi, qǐngwèn Wáng Yíwén xiǎojiě zài ma?
B1L13-1-01.english: Hello, may I ask, is Miss Wang Yiwen there?

B1L13-1-04.chinese: 我剛剛在學校附近看到中明。
B1L13-1-04.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng zài xuéxiào fùjìn kàndào Zhōngmíng.
B1L13-1-04.english: I just now saw Zhongming near the school.

B1L13-1-06.chinese: 這是博物館的網址，你可以先看看。
B1L13-1-06.pinyin: Zhè shì bówùguǎn de wǎngzhǐ, nǐ kěyǐ xiān kànkan.
B1L13-1-06.english: This is the museum's web address; you can take a look first.

B1L13-1-07.chinese: 我生病了，媽媽今天要帶我去醫院看醫生。
B1L13-1-07.pinyin: Wǒ shēngbìng le, māma jīntiān yào dài wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn yīshēng.
B1L13-1-07.english: I got sick; my mom is going to take me to the hospital to see a doctor today.

B1L13-1-08.chinese: 老闆今天帶我去參觀了一家工廠。
B1L13-1-08.pinyin: Lǎobǎn jīntiān dài wǒ qù cānguān le yì jiā gōngchǎng.
B1L13-1-08.english: The boss took me to visit a factory today.

B1L13-1-09.chinese: 學校的網站上有很多學生寫的文章。
B1L13-1-09.pinyin: Xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn shàng yǒu hěn duō xuéshēng xiě de wénzhāng.
B1L13-1-09.english: On the school's website there are many articles written by students.

B1L13-1-10.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā jiā de dìzhǐ ma?
B1L13-1-10.english: Do you know his home address?

B1L13-1-12.chinese: 我往右看，看到了一間很漂亮的房子。
B1L13-1-12.pinyin: Wǒ wǎng yòu kàn, kàndào le yì jiān hěn piàoliang de fángzi.
B1L13-1-12.english: I looked to the right and saw a very beautiful house.

B1L13-1-14.chinese: 你先往左轉，再往右轉，就到那家餐廳了。
B1L13-1-14.pinyin: Nǐ xiān wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn, zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn, jiù dào nà jiā cāntīng le.
B1L13-1-14.english: First turn left, then turn right, and you'll arrive at that restaurant.

B1L13-1-15.chinese: 我明天早上十點會在學校門口等你。
B1L13-1-15.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn huì zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
B1L13-1-15.english: I will wait for you at the school gate at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.

B1L13-1-16.chinese: B:好，沒問題？ A:我們明天晚上八點見。
B1L13-1-16.pinyin: B: Hǎo, méi wèntí? A: Wǒmen míngtiān wǎnshang bā diǎn jiàn.
B1L13-1-16.english: B: Okay, no problem? A: Let's see each other at eight tomorrow evening.

B1L13-1-17.chinese: 現在很晚了，你應該去睡覺了。
B1L13-1-17.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn wǎn le, nǐ yīnggāi qù shuìjiào le.
B1L13-1-17.english: It's very late now; you should go to sleep.

B1L13-1-18.chinese: 現在十點了，不早了，我想回家了。
B1L13-1-18.pinyin: Xiànzài shí diǎn le, bù zǎo le, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā le.
B1L13-1-18.english: It's ten o'clock now; it's not early anymore, I want to go home.

B1L13-2-01.chinese: 他下個月就要回國了，我想送他一些小禮物。
B1L13-2-01.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè jiù yào huí guó le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yìxiē xiǎo lǐwù.
B1L13-2-01.english: He is about to return to his country next month; I want to give him some small gifts.

B1L13-2-02.chinese: 現在坐捷運的人很多，我們需要排隊。
B1L13-2-02.pinyin: Xiànzài zuò jiéyùn de rén hěn duō, wǒmen xūyào páiduì.
B1L13-2-02.english: There are many people taking the MRT now; we need to line up.

B1L13-2-03.chinese: 我同學送了我一張電影票，可是我沒有空去看。
B1L13-2-03.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué sòng le wǒ yì zhāng diànyǐng piào, kěshì wǒ méiyǒu kòng qù kàn.
B1L13-2-03.english: My classmate gave me a movie ticket, but I don't have time to go see it.

B1L13-2-04.chinese: 他今天給我介紹了一個新朋友。
B1L13-2-04.pinyin: Tā jīntiān gěi wǒ jièshào le yí ge xīn péngyou.
B1L13-2-04.english: Today he introduced a new friend to me.

B1L13-2-05.chinese: 他們在裡面談話，你現在不要進去。
B1L13-2-05.pinyin: Tāmen zài lǐmiàn tánhuà, nǐ xiànzài búyào jìnqù.
B1L13-2-05.english: They are talking inside; don't go in now.

B1L13-2-06.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng, qǐng jìnlái ba!
B1L13-2-06.english: It's very cold outside; please come in!

B1L13-2-07.chinese: 圖書館裡的人都在看書，很安靜。
B1L13-2-07.pinyin: Túshūguǎn lǐ de rén dōu zài kàn shū, hěn ānjìng.
B1L13-2-07.english: Everyone in the library is reading, so it is very quiet.

B1L13-2-08.chinese: 兒子跟女兒都在睡覺，你不要說得太大聲。
B1L13-2-08.pinyin: Érzi gēn nǚ'ér dōu zài shuìjiào, nǐ búyào shuō de tài dàshēng.
B1L13-2-08.english: Both my son and daughter are sleeping; don't speak too loudly.

B1L13-2-09.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, zhè shì shénme shēngyīn?

B1L13-2-10.chinese: 這個網站上的圖片很多，而且都很好看。
B1L13-2-10.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn shàng de túpiàn hěn duō, érqiě dōu hěn hǎokàn.
B1L13-2-10.english: There are many pictures on this website, and they all look great.

B1L13-2-11.chinese: 我問了他一個問題，他馬上就回答了。
B1L13-2-11.pinyin: Wǒ wèn le tā yí ge wèntí, tā mǎshàng jiù huídá le.
B1L13-2-11.english: I asked him a question, and he answered immediately.

B1L13-2-13.chinese: 我看過很多有趣的歷史故事。
B1L13-2-13.pinyin: Wǒ kàn guo hěn duō yǒuqù de lìshǐ gùshi.
B1L13-2-13.english: I have read many interesting historical stories.

B1L13-3-01.chinese: 請你先算一算，然後告訴我這裡一共有多少人。
B1L13-3-01.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiān suàn yi suàn, ránhòu gàosu wǒ zhèlǐ yígòng yǒu duōshao rén.
B1L13-3-01.english: Please calculate first, then tell me how many people there are here in total.

B1L13-3-02.chinese: 這幾個數學問題我都不懂，不知道怎麼算。
B1L13-3-02.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge shùxué wèntí wǒ dōu bù dǒng, bù zhīdào zěnme suàn.
B1L13-3-02.english: I don't understand any of these math problems; I don't know how to calculate them.

B1L13-3-03.chinese: 語言和科學我都很喜歡。
B1L13-3-03.pinyin: Yǔyán hé kēxué wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
B1L13-3-03.english: I like both language and science.

B1L13-3-04.chinese: 下個月有個很大的電腦展，你要跟我去看看嗎？
B1L13-3-04.pinyin: Xià ge yuè yǒu ge hěn dà de diànnǎo zhǎn, nǐ yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan ma?
B1L13-3-04.english: Next month there is a big computer exhibition; do you want to go see it with me?

B1L13-3-05.chinese: 我出了捷運站，就看到那家銀行了。
B1L13-3-05.pinyin: Wǒ chū le jiéyùn zhàn, jiù kàndào nà jiā yínháng le.
B1L13-3-05.english: As soon as I exited the MRT station, I saw that bank.

B1L13-3-06.chinese: 這是往博物館的方向嗎？
B1L13-3-06.pinyin: Zhè shì wǎng bówùguǎn de fāngxiàng ma?
B1L13-3-06.english: Is this the direction to the museum?

B1L13-3-07.chinese: 我們要過馬路，到對面去坐公車。
B1L13-3-07.pinyin: Wǒmen yào guò mǎlù, dào duìmiàn qù zuò gōngchē.
B1L13-3-07.english: We need to cross the road to go to the opposite side to take the bus.

B1L13-3-10.chinese: 你往前走，過第二個十字路口，就到了。
B1L13-3-10.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, guò dì èr ge shízì lùkǒu, jiù dào le.
B1L13-3-10.english: Go straight ahead, pass the second intersection, and you'll arrive.

B1L13-3-11.chinese: 他不是壞人，你不要怕他。
B1L13-3-11.pinyin: Tā bú shì huàirén, nǐ búyào pà tā.
B1L13-3-11.english: He is not a bad person; don't be afraid of him.

B1L13-3-12.chinese: 世界很大，沒去過的地方我都想去。
B1L13-3-12.pinyin: Shìjiè hěn dà, méi qù guo de dìfang wǒ dōu xiǎng qù.
B1L13-3-12.english: The world is big; I want to go to all the places I haven't been to.

B1L13-3-13.chinese: 我在台灣的生活不錯，很喜歡這裡，也有很多好朋友。
B1L13-3-13.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiwān de shēnghuó búcuò, hěn xǐhuan zhèlǐ, yě yǒu hěn duō hǎo péngyou.
B1L13-3-13.english: My life in Taiwan is good; I like it here a lot, and I also have many good friends.

B1L13-3-14.chinese: 你不要忘了告訴他明天有考試。
B1L13-3-14.pinyin: Nǐ búyào wàng le gàosu tā míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì.
B1L13-3-14.english: Don't forget to tell him that there is an exam tomorrow.

B1L13-3-15.chinese: 你知道現在世界上有多少人嗎？
B1L13-3-15.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào xiànzài shìjiè shàng yǒu duōshao rén ma?
B1L13-3-15.english: Do you know how many people there are in the world now?

B1L14-1-01.chinese: 今年你想要跟誰一起跨年？
B1L14-1-01.pinyin: Jīnnián nǐ xiǎng gēn shéi yìqǐ kuànián?
B1L14-1-01.english: Who do you want to celebrate New Year's Eve with this year?

B1L14-1-02.chinese: 來台灣以後，每個週末我都有很多活動，覺得很開心。
B1L14-1-02.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu yǒu hěn duō huódòng, juéde hěn kāixīn.
B1L14-1-02.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have many activities every weekend and feel very happy.

B1L14-1-03.chinese: 我已經在台北住了三十年了。
B1L14-1-03.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zài Táiběi zhù le sānshí nián le.
B1L14-1-03.english: I have already lived in Taipei for thirty years.

B1L14-1-04.chinese: 你參加過什麼有趣的新年活動？
B1L14-1-04.pinyin: Nǐ cānjiā guò shénme yǒuqù de xīnnián huódòng?
B1L14-1-04.english: What interesting New Year activities have you participated in?

B1L14-1-05.chinese: 這是我第一次來台灣，我覺得好開心。
B1L14-1-05.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái Táiwān, wǒ juéde hǎo kāixīn.
B1L14-1-05.english: This is my first time coming to Taiwan, I feel very happy.

B1L14-1-06.chinese: 明天是老師的生日，我們要送他一個大蛋糕，給他過生日。
B1L14-1-06.pinyin: Míngtiān shì lǎoshī de shēngrì, wǒmen yào sòng tā yī gè dà dàngāo, gěi tā guò shēngrì.
B1L14-1-06.english: Tomorrow is the teacher's birthday, we will give him a big cake to celebrate his birthday.

B1L14-1-07.chinese: 我買了三個麵包，吃了兩個了，最後一個明天再吃。
B1L14-1-07.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le sān gè miànbāo, chī le liǎng gè le, zuìhòu yī gè míngtiān zài chī.
B1L14-1-07.english: I bought three breads, I have eaten two, I will eat the last one tomorrow.

B1L14-1-09.chinese: 明天晚上學校有一個新年晚會，你會去參加嗎？
B1L14-1-09.pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshang xuéxiào yǒu yī gè xīnnián wǎnhuì, nǐ huì qù cānjiā ma?
B1L14-1-09.english: Tomorrow evening the school has a New Year evening event, will you go to participate?

B1L14-1-12.chinese: 這個週末有一場演唱會，你要不要跟我一起去看？
B1L14-1-12.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng yǎnchànghuì, nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù kàn?
B1L14-1-12.english: This weekend there is a concert, do you want to go watch it with me?

B1L14-1-13.chinese: 今天晚會上的表演都非常好看。
B1L14-1-13.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnhuì shàng de biǎoyǎn dōu fēicháng hǎokàn.
B1L14-1-13.english: The performances at today's evening event are all very good-looking.

B1L14-1-14.chinese: 每天早上公園裡都有很多人在運動，非常熱鬧。
B1L14-1-14.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang gōngyuán lǐ dōu yǒu hěn duō rén zài yùndòng, fēicháng rènao.
B1L14-1-14.english: Every morning in the park there are many people exercising, it is very lively.

B1L14-1-15.chinese: 他的表演很有意思，我們大家看得很開心。
B1L14-1-15.pinyin: Tā de biǎoyǎn hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒmen dàjiā kàn de hěn kāixīn.
B1L14-1-15.english: His performance is very interesting, we all watched it very happily.

B1L14-1-16.chinese: 我站了兩個小時了，好累！
B1L14-1-16.pinyin: Wǒ zhàn le liǎng gè xiǎoshí le, hǎo lèi!
B1L14-1-16.english: I have been standing for two hours, so tired!

B1L14-1-17.chinese: 我已經坐了四、五個小時了，想出去走走！
B1L14-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zuò le sì, wǔ gè xiǎoshí le, xiǎng chūqù zǒuzou!
B1L14-1-17.english: I have already been sitting for four or five hours, I want to go out and walk around!

B1L14-1-18.chinese: 我在客廳等了他一晚，真累！
B1L14-1-18.pinyin: Wǒ zài kètīng děng le tā yī wǎn, zhēn lèi!
B1L14-1-18.english: I waited for him in the living room all evening, really tired!

B1L14-1-19.chinese: 那件衣服有一點兒舊，可是還可以穿很久。
B1L14-1-19.pinyin: Nà jiàn yīfu yǒu yīdiǎnr jiù, kěshì hái kěyǐ chuān hěn jiǔ.
B1L14-1-19.english: That piece of clothing is a little old, but can still be worn for a long time.

B1L14-1-20.chinese: 他住的那棟大樓附近有學校，也有餐廳。
B1L14-1-20.pinyin: Tā zhù de nà dòng dàlóu fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yě yǒu cāntīng.
B1L14-1-20.english: Near the building where he lives there is a school, and also a restaurant.

B1L14-1-21.chinese: 你看書看了多久了？不累嗎？
B1L14-1-21.pinyin: Nǐ kàn shū kàn le duōjiǔ le? Bù lèi ma?
B1L14-1-21.english: How long have you been reading? Aren't you tired?

B1L14-1-23.chinese: 台北是一個又熱鬧又方便的城市。
B1L14-1-23.pinyin: Táiběi shì yī gè yòu rènao yòu fāngbiàn de chéngshì.
B1L14-1-23.english: Taipei is a city that is both lively and convenient.

B1L14-2-01.chinese: 大家都歡迎新老師到我們學校來。
B1L14-2-01.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huānyíng xīn lǎoshī dào wǒmen xuéxiào lái.
B1L14-2-01.english: Everyone welcomes the new teacher to come to our school.

B1L14-2-02.chinese: 歡迎你們到我家來，請進。
B1L14-2-02.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐmen dào wǒ jiā lái, qǐng jìn.
B1L14-2-02.english: Welcome to my home, please come in.

B1L14-2-03.chinese: 我們往前走，很快就到公園了。
B1L14-2-03.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎng qián zǒu, hěn kuài jiù dào gōngyuán le.
B1L14-2-03.english: We walk forward, and we will soon arrive at the park.

B1L14-2-05.chinese: 這個公園裡有幾棵又高又大的樹。
B1L14-2-05.pinyin: Zhè ge gōngyuán lǐ yǒu jǐ kē yòu gāo yòu dà de shù.
B1L14-2-05.english: In this park there are several tall and big trees.

B1L14-2-06.chinese: 這裡的環境不錯，可是附近沒有捷運站，交通不方便。
B1L14-2-06.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng bùcuò, kěshì fùjìn méiyǒu jiéyùn zhàn, jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn.
B1L14-2-06.english: The environment here is not bad, but there is no MRT station nearby, transportation is not convenient.

B1L14-2-07.chinese: 這個孩子還太小，不能喝酒。
B1L14-2-07.pinyin: Zhè ge háizi hái tài xiǎo, bù néng hē jiǔ.
B1L14-2-07.english: This child is still too young, cannot drink alcohol.

B1L14-2-08.chinese: 如果你不想吃飯，可以只吃幾個餃子。
B1L14-2-08.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎng chī fàn, kěyǐ zhǐ chī jǐ gè jiǎozi.
B1L14-2-08.english: If you don't want to eat rice, you can just eat a few dumplings.

B1L14-2-09.chinese: 這是我媽媽做的包子，你吃吃看。
B1L14-2-09.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ māma zuò de bāozi, nǐ chī chī kàn.
B1L14-2-09.english: These are baozi made by my mother, try eating them.

B1L14-2-10.chinese: 從這裡往山上走，你就會看到很多牛。
B1L14-2-10.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng shān shàng zǒu, nǐ jiù huì kàndào hěn duō niú.
B1L14-2-10.english: If you walk up the mountain from here, you will see many cows.

B1L14-2-11.chinese: 我喜歡吃肉，可是我吃得不多。
B1L14-2-11.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī ròu, kěshì wǒ chī de bù duō.
B1L14-2-11.english: I like to eat meat, but I don't eat much.

B1L14-2-12.chinese: 這條魚很好吃，你多吃點兒。
B1L14-2-12.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú hěn hǎochī, nǐ duō chī diǎnr.
B1L14-2-12.english: This fish is delicious, eat a little more.

B1L14-2-13.chinese: 天氣熱的時候，我不喜歡喝熱湯。
B1L14-2-13.pinyin: Tiānqì rè de shíhòu, wǒ bù xǐhuān hē rè tāng.
B1L14-2-13.english: When the weather is hot, I don't like to drink hot soup.

B1L14-2-14.chinese: 你很餓嗎？為什麼吃得這麼快？
B1L14-2-14.pinyin: Nǐ hěn è ma? Wèishénme chī de zhème kuài?
B1L14-2-14.english: Are you very hungry? Why are you eating so fast?

B1L14-2-15.chinese: 帶這麼重的東西，走了兩個小時，我覺得很累。
B1L14-2-15.pinyin: Dài zhème zhòng de dōngxī, zǒu le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, wǒ juéde hěn lèi.
B1L14-2-15.english: Carrying such heavy things and walking for two hours, I feel very tired.

B1L14-2-16.chinese: 你手裡拿的東西是什麼？
B1L14-2-16.pinyin: Nǐ shǒu lǐ ná de dōngxī shì shénme?
B1L14-2-16.english: What is the thing you are holding in your hand?

B1L14-2-17.chinese: 我們上禮拜到山上去看日出了，好漂亮！
B1L14-2-17.pinyin: Wǒmen shàng lǐbài dào shān shàng qù kàn rìchū le, hǎo piàoliang!
B1L14-2-17.english: Last week we went up the mountain to see the sunrise; it was so beautiful!

B1L14-2-18.chinese: 我每個星期天早上都跟家人去教堂。
B1L14-2-18.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqītiān zǎoshang dōu gēn jiārén qù jiàotáng.
B1L14-2-18.english: Every Sunday morning I go to church with my family.

B1L14-2-19.chinese: 我覺得打球比跑步有意思，我常跟朋友一起打籃球。
B1L14-2-19.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dǎqiú bǐ pǎobù yǒu yìsi, wǒ cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú.
B1L14-2-19.english: I think playing ball is more interesting than running; I often play basketball with friends.

B1L14-2-20.chinese: A:我覺得語言比數學有趣多了？ B:我同意你說的。
B1L14-2-20.pinyin: A: Wǒ juéde yǔyán bǐ shùxué yǒuqù duō le? B: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ shuō de.
B1L14-2-20.english: A: I think languages are much more interesting than math? B: I agree with what you said.

B1L14-3-01.chinese: 來台灣以後，我認識了很多國家的新朋友。
B1L14-3-01.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, wǒ rènshi le hěn duō guójiā de xīn péngyǒu.
B1L14-3-01.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have met many new friends from many countries.

B1L14-3-02.chinese: 你知道台灣人怎麼慶祝新年嗎？
B1L14-3-02.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào Táiwān rén zěnme qìngzhù xīnnián ma?
B1L14-3-02.english: Do you know how Taiwanese people celebrate the New Year?

B1L14-3-03.chinese: 從我家去捷運站，過一條街就到了，交通很方便。
B1L14-3-03.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā qù jiéyùn zhàn, guò yì tiáo jiē jiù dào le, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
B1L14-3-03.english: From my home to the MRT station, cross one street and you're there; the transportation is very convenient.

B1L14-3-04.chinese: 我哥哥是警察，他每天工作十個小時。
B1L14-3-04.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì jǐngchá, tā měitiān gōngzuò shí ge xiǎoshí.
B1L14-3-04.english: My older brother is a police officer; he works ten hours every day.

B1L14-3-05.chinese: 走路跟騎腳踏車的時候，我們都要小心。
B1L14-3-05.pinyin: Zǒulù gēn qí jiǎotàchē de shíhòu, wǒmen dōu yào xiǎoxīn.
B1L14-3-05.english: When walking and riding a bicycle, we all need to be careful.

B1L14-3-06.chinese: 他因為打籃球的時候不小心，所以手受傷了。
B1L14-3-06.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi dǎ lánqiú de shíhòu bù xiǎoxīn, suǒyǐ shǒu shòushāng le.
B1L14-3-06.english: Because he was not careful when playing basketball, his hand got injured.

B1L15-1-02.chinese: 我們今天要學第十五課，老師會給我們介紹十二生肖。
B1L15-1-02.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, lǎoshī huì gěi wǒmen jièshào shí'èr shēngxiào.
B1L15-1-02.english: Today we are going to study Lesson 15; the teacher will introduce the twelve zodiac signs to us.

B1L15-1-04.chinese: 她很喜歡小動物，想要有一隻小狗。
B1L15-1-04.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān xiǎo dòngwù, xiǎng yào yǒu yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
B1L15-1-04.english: She likes small animals very much and wants to have a little dog.

B1L15-1-06.chinese: 同學們，現在請打開課本，我們看第十五課。
B1L15-1-06.pinyin: Tóngxuémen, xiànzài qǐng dǎkāi kèběn, wǒmen kàn dì shíwǔ kè.
B1L15-1-06.english: Classmates, now please open your textbooks; we are looking at Lesson 15.

B1L15-1-07.chinese: 這課的課文很有意思，我很喜歡。
B1L15-1-07.pinyin: Zhè kè de kèwén hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
B1L15-1-07.english: The text of this lesson is very interesting; I like it very much.

B1L15-1-08.chinese: A:對不起，我不小心拿了你的書？ B:原來書在你這裡，我剛才在教室裡找了好久。
B1L15-1-08.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn ná le nǐ de shū? B: Yuánlái shū zài nǐ zhèlǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ.
B1L15-1-08.english: A: Sorry, I accidentally took your book? B: It turns out the book is here with you; I was looking in the classroom for a long time just now.

B1L15-1-10.chinese: 華人和日本人都有十二生肖，十二生肖的動物也一樣嗎？
B1L15-1-10.pinyin: Huárén hé Rìběnrén dōu yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, shí'èr shēngxiào de dòngwù yě yíyàng ma?
B1L15-1-10.english: Chinese people and Japanese people both have the twelve zodiac signs; are the animals of the twelve zodiac signs also the same?

B1L15-1-11.chinese: 華人用十二生肖代表每一年。他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
B1L15-1-11.pinyin: Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián. Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
B1L15-1-11.english: Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year. He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

B1L15-1-13.chinese: 我是2005年七月在越南出生的。
B1L15-1-13.pinyin: Wǒ shì èr líng líng wǔ nián qīyuè zài Yuènán chūshēng de.
B1L15-1-13.english: I was born in Vietnam in July 2005.

B1L15-1-14.pinyin: Yī jiǔ jiǔ qī nián chūshēng de rén shǔ shénme shēngxiào?
B1L15-1-14.english: What zodiac sign do people born in 1997 belong to?

B1L15-1-15.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
B1L15-1-15.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
B1L15-1-15.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

B1L15-1-16.chinese: 大家都覺得做這個菜不難，很簡單。
B1L15-1-16.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu juéde zuò zhège cài bù nán, hěn jiǎndān.
B1L15-1-16.english: Everyone feels that making this dish is not hard; it's very simple.

B1L15-1-17.chinese: 我不知道那個地方怎麼去，所以應該先查查地圖。
B1L15-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nàge dìfāng zěnme qù, suǒyǐ yīnggāi xiān chácha dìtú.
B1L15-1-17.english: I don't know how to get to that place, so I should first check the map.

B1L15-2-01.chinese: 他手裡拿著禮物，在學校門口等著女朋友。
B1L15-2-01.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe lǐwù, zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děngzhe nǚpéngyǒu.
B1L15-2-01.english: He is holding a gift in his hand and is waiting for his girlfriend at the school entrance.

B1L15-2-03.chinese: 明天我要跟朋友去參加跨年活動，我還沒跟父母講這件事。
B1L15-2-03.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào gēn péngyǒu qù cānjiā kuànián huódòng, wǒ hái méi gēn fùmǔ jiǎng zhè jiàn shì.
B1L15-2-03.english: Tomorrow I'm going with friends to attend a New Year's Eve event; I still haven't talked to my parents about this.

B1L15-2-04.chinese: 他在跟家人談事情，已經講了三十分鐘的話了。
B1L15-2-04.pinyin: Tā zài gēn jiārén tán shìqíng, yǐjīng jiǎngle sānshí fēnzhōng de huà le.
B1L15-2-04.english: He is discussing something with his family; he has already been talking for thirty minutes.

B1L15-2-05.chinese: 我記得去年跟幾個朋友一起打過籃球，真好玩。
B1L15-2-05.pinyin: Wǒ jìde qùnián gēn jǐ gè péngyǒu yīqǐ dǎguo lánqiú, zhēn hǎowán.
B1L15-2-05.english: I remember last year I played basketball with a few friends; it was really fun.

B1L15-2-07.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，大人、小孩都應該多注意身體。
B1L15-2-07.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ.
B1L15-2-07.english: Recently many people have colds; both adults and children should pay more attention to their health.

B1L15-2-09.chinese: 元宵節燈會是華人新年的重要活動。
B1L15-2-09.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié dēnghuì shì Huárén xīnnián de zhòngyào huódòng.
B1L15-2-09.english: The Lantern Festival Lantern Carnival is an important event for Chinese New Year.

B1L15-3-02.chinese: 桌子上放著很多張紙，都是弟弟要寫的書法作業。
B1L15-3-02.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe hěn duō zhāng zhǐ, dōu shì dìdi yào xiě de shūfǎ zuòyè.
B1L15-3-02.english: There are many sheets of paper placed on the table; they are all the calligraphy homework that my younger brother needs to write.

B1L15-3-05.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
B1L15-3-05.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
B1L15-3-05.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

B1L15-3-08.chinese: 他跑得很快，如果跟他比賽，我沒有機會贏，一定會輸。
B1L15-3-08.pinyin: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài, rúguǒ gēn tā bǐsài, wǒ méiyǒu jīhuì yíng, yīdìng huì shū.
B1L15-3-08.english: He runs very fast; if I compete with him, I have no chance of winning—I will definitely lose.

B1L15-3-09.chinese: 公園的音樂晚會快要開始了，可不可以請你們幫我排那些椅子？
B1L15-3-09.pinyin: Gōngyuán de yīnyuè wǎnhuì kuài yào kāishǐ le, kě bù kěyǐ qǐng nǐmen bāng wǒ pái nàxiē yǐzi?
B1L15-3-09.english: The park's music evening party is about to start; could you please help me line up those chairs?

B1L15-3-10.chinese: 我只參加過籃球比賽，其他運動比賽我都沒有經驗。
B1L15-3-10.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ cānjiāguo lánqiú bǐsài, qítā yùndòng bǐsài wǒ dōu méiyǒu jīngyàn.
B1L15-3-10.english: I have only participated in basketball competitions; I have no experience in other sports competitions.

B1L15-3-16.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
B1L15-3-16.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
B1L15-3-16.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

B1L16-1-01.chinese: 我喜歡去旅行，因為可以認識很多有趣的人。
B1L16-1-01.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān qù lǚxíng, yīnwèi kěyǐ rènshi hěn duō yǒuqù de rén.
B1L16-1-01.english: I like to travel because I can meet many interesting people.

B1L16-1-02.chinese: 下個月放四天假，我打算帶家人去日本玩。
B1L16-1-02.pinyin: Xià gè yuè fàng sì tiān jià, wǒ dǎsuàn dài jiārén qù Rìběn wán.
B1L16-1-02.english: Next month we have four days off; I plan to take my family to Japan for fun.

B1L16-1-03.chinese: 他的計畫是畢業以後到美國去工作。
B1L16-1-03.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shì bìyè yǐhòu dào Měiguó qù gōngzuò.
B1L16-1-03.english: His plan is to go to the United States to work after graduation.

B1L16-1-06.chinese: 上次我們吃牛肉麵，這次也吃牛肉麵，下次吃別的吧。
B1L16-1-06.pinyin: Shàng cì wǒmen chī niúròumiàn, zhè cì yě chī niúròumiàn, xià cì chī bié de ba.
B1L16-1-06.english: Last time we ate beef noodles, this time we're also eating beef noodles; next time let's eat something else.

B1L16-1-07.chinese: 那家新的百貨公司離這裡遠嗎？
B1L16-1-07.pinyin: Nà jiā xīn de bǎihuò gōngsī lí zhèlǐ yuǎn ma?
B1L16-1-07.english: Is that new department store far from here?

B1L16-1-10.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
B1L16-1-10.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
B1L16-1-10.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

B1L16-1-12.chinese: 放假的時候，很多台灣人喜歡到東部去玩。
B1L16-1-12.pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhòu, hěn duō Táiwānrén xǐhuān dào dōngbù qù wán.
B1L16-1-12.english: During holidays, many Taiwanese people like to go to the eastern part (of Taiwan) for fun.

B1L16-1-13.chinese: 從中部坐車到南部去，差不多要兩個小時。
B1L16-1-13.pinyin: Cóng zhōngbù zuò chē dào nánbù qù, chàbuduō yào liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
B1L16-1-13.english: Taking a bus from the central part to the southern part takes about two hours.

B1L16-1-16.chinese: 我們從小學到大學都是同學，也是很好的朋友。
B1L16-1-16.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng xiǎoxué dào dàxué dōu shì tóngxué, yě shì hěn hǎo de péngyǒu.
B1L16-1-16.english: From elementary school to university, we have always been classmates and also very good friends.

B1L16-1-17.chinese: 我弟弟是小學四年級的學生。
B1L16-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi shì xiǎoxué sì niánjí de xuéshēng.
B1L16-1-17.english: My younger brother is a fourth-grade elementary school student.

B1L16-1-18.chinese: 爸爸每天早上一起床就看報紙。
B1L16-1-18.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yì qǐchuáng jiù kàn bàozhǐ.
B1L16-1-18.english: Every morning as soon as Dad gets out of bed, he reads the newspaper.

B1L16-1-21.chinese: 因為最近常常下雪，所以交通很不方便。
B1L16-1-21.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn chángcháng xià xuě, suǒyǐ jiāotōng hěn bù fāngbiàn.
B1L16-1-21.english: Because it has often been snowing recently, transportation is very inconvenient.

B1L16-1-23.chinese: 從昨天晚上到現在，已經下了十個小時的雨了。
B1L16-1-23.pinyin: Cóng zuótiān wǎnshang dào xiànzài, yǐjīng xià le shí ge xiǎoshí de yǔ le.
B1L16-1-23.english: From last night until now, it has already rained for ten hours.

B1L16-1-24.chinese: 我跟朋友這次去英國玩了八天七夜。
B1L16-1-24.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou zhè cì qù Yīngguó wán le bā tiān qī yè.
B1L16-1-24.english: This time I went to England with a friend and played for eight days and seven nights.

B1L16-2-02.chinese: 我今天本來想去看電影，後來下雨就沒去了。
B1L16-2-02.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān běnlái xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng, hòulái xià yǔ jiù méi qù le.
B1L16-2-02.english: Today I originally wanted to go see a movie, but later it rained so I didn't go.

B1L16-2-03.chinese: 聽說高鐵很快，你搭過沒有？
B1L16-2-03.pinyin: Tīngshuō gāotiě hěn kuài, nǐ dā guo méiyǒu?
B1L16-2-03.english: I heard the high-speed rail is very fast; have you ever taken it?

B1L16-2-04.chinese: 今年的表演比去年的更有意思，我覺得你應該來看。
B1L16-2-04.pinyin: Jīnnián de biǎoyǎn bǐ qùnián de gèng yǒu yìsi, wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi lái kàn.
B1L16-2-04.english: This year's performance is even more interesting than last year's; I think you should come see it.

B1L16-2-06.chinese: 捷運站的洗手間外面有很多人在排隊，你要去嗎？
B1L16-2-06.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhàn de xǐshǒujiān wàimiàn yǒu hěn duō rén zài páiduì, nǐ yào qù ma?
B1L16-2-06.english: Outside the restroom at the MRT station there are many people lining up; do you want to go?

B1L16-2-07.chinese: 哥哥洗澡以後都先喝一瓶牛奶再睡覺。
B1L16-2-07.pinyin: Gēge xǐzǎo yǐhòu dōu xiān hē yì píng niúnǎi zài shuìjiào.
B1L16-2-07.english: After my older brother takes a shower, he always first drinks a bottle of milk and then goes to sleep.

B1L16-2-08.chinese: 我想先換衣服再去運動。
B1L16-2-08.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān huàn yīfu zài qù yùndòng.
B1L16-2-08.english: I want to change clothes first and then go exercise.

B1L16-2-09.chinese: 你先幫我付，我明天再給你錢。
B1L16-2-09.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bāng wǒ fù, wǒ míngtiān zài gěi nǐ qián.
B1L16-2-09.english: You pay for me first; I'll give you the money tomorrow.

B1L16-2-10.chinese: 為什麼她咖啡喝了一半就不喝了？
B1L16-2-10.pinyin: Wèishénme tā kāfēi hē le yíbàn jiù bù hē le?
B1L16-2-10.english: Why did she drink half of her coffee and then stop drinking?

B1L16-2-11.chinese: 晚上的風很舒服，我們一起出去走走吧。
B1L16-2-11.pinyin: Wǎnshang de fēng hěn shūfu, wǒmen yìqǐ chūqù zǒuzou ba.
B1L16-2-11.english: The evening wind is very comfortable; let's go out for a walk together.

B1L16-2-12.chinese: 這張照片裡的人都笑得很開心。
B1L16-2-12.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn lǐ de rén dōu xiào de hěn kāixīn.
B1L16-2-12.english: The people in this photo are all smiling very happily.

B1L16-3-01.chinese: 左邊的照片比右邊的好看。
B1L16-3-01.pinyin: Zuǒbiān de zhàopiàn bǐ yòubiān de hǎokàn.
B1L16-3-01.english: The photo on the left side is better looking than the one on the right side.

B1L16-3-05.chinese: 台灣從北到南有三百八十五公里。
B1L16-3-05.pinyin: Táiwān cóng běi dào nán yǒu sānbǎi bāshíwǔ gōnglǐ.
B1L16-3-05.english: Taiwan is 385 kilometers from north to south.

B1L16-3-08.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
B1L16-3-08.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
B1L16-3-08.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

B1L16-3-09.chinese: 我每天上學以前，一定先在家吃早飯。
B1L16-3-09.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shàngxué yǐqián, yídìng xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
B1L16-3-09.english: Every day before I go to school, I always eat breakfast at home first.

B1L16-3-10.chinese: 夜市裡有很多有名的食物，又便宜又好吃。
B1L16-3-10.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ yǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de shíwù, yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
B1L16-3-10.english: There is a lot of famous food in the night market; it's both cheap and delicious.

B1L16-3-11.chinese: 夏天的時候，食物不能在外面放太久。
B1L16-3-11.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, shíwù bù néng zài wàimiàn fàng tài jiǔ.
B1L16-3-11.english: In summer, food cannot be left outside for too long.

B1L16-3-12.chinese: 他喜歡玩手機遊戲，差不多每天玩兩個小時。
B1L16-3-12.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan wán shǒujī yóuxì, chàbuduō měitiān wán liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
B1L16-3-12.english: He likes to play mobile games, and plays for about two hours almost every day.
